summary: Anyscale's pricing page and homepage both advertise $100 in Anyscale Credits for getting started. The pricing page says to 'Start building with a free Anyscale account and access to dozens of code templates on Anyscale Platform.' The pricing page publishes no expiry, card, or eligibility terms for the credit.
claim_steps: Open https://www.anyscale.com/pricing and click 'Get started with $100 credit'
Sign up for a free Anyscale account
